_comment: Andy's lines, rotated with no immediate repeats. Add as many as you like. 'catchphrases' play when Andy sorts something out; 'grumbles' when a scrape is missed; 'crash' when Andy wipes out; 'bumped' is what other skiers say when Andy flattens them; 'apres' is the evening in the bar, one picked per day; 'leedsBanter'/'leedsReplies' are Banter Bob and Andy; 'chairman' is the Club Chairman ringing Andy on holiday; 'lee', 'alistair' and the rest are what those people say.
catchphrases: A problem, but not my problem.
Have you tried turning it off and leaving?
Thirty five years I've been doing this.
Popular as a pork chop in a synagogue.
Not my circus, not my clowns.
How is the wonderful, the delectable Strewth?
You have two hopes and Bob is banging out tunes
As useful as an ashtray on a motorbike
Did I tell you about the bloke from MI5?
I saw half a bloke in a lift shaft
Katie Chalk, do do do do do do
Ski? I've been skiing since before you were born.
Who brought the lads? Never again.
It's not a holiday, it's a hostage situation.
Eighty quid for a lift pass. EIGHTY QUID.
Seven euros for a hot chocolate!
grumbles: I could have gone to Skegness.
crash: I'm fine. I MEANT to do that.
Thirty five years I've been doing this.
Not on my watch. Apparently it IS on my watch.
air: Eddie the Eagle, eat your heart out!
leedsBanter: When did Leeds last win anything? 1992?
Marching on together... to the Championship!
leedsReplies: Leeds are the greatest club in the world. END OF.
You're not fit to wipe Billy Bremner's boots!
We're Leeds and we're proud of it!
chairman: Andy! Quick one. Where's the key to the kit cupboard?
Andy, it's the Chairman. Are you on holiday? Since when?
We need the Under-8s' subs spreadsheet. Today.
Mrs Pemberton's complained. About your out-of-office.
Can you do training on Saturday? From the Alps?
fobOffs: I'm halfway up a mountain, Chairman.
Ask Gaz. Yes, I know. Ask him anyway.
It's in the drawer. No, the OTHER drawer.
lee: On your left! On your right! On your EVERYTHING!
Out of the way, I'm on a segment!
alistair: I'm not banned in THIS country!
apres: Plug has ordered a tower of something blue. Andy wants a cup of tea.
Kinky Steve is dancing on the table in his onesie. The barman has called someone.
Jimmy Ginge has gone the colour of a postbox. 'It's a tan,' he says.
The Aging Rocker has commandeered the karaoke. Power ballads until 2am.
Sid fell asleep in his fondue.
KFT says tomorrow he knows a quicker way down. Andy's eye is twitching.
Somebody has put Andy's ski boots in the hot tub.
Plug has fallen off his bar stool. In a bar with no ski slope in it.
The chalet host asks who left the shower running. All eyes on Sid.

dayIntro.green: A gentle start. Even Plug can do this one. Probably.
dayIntro.blue: Wide, friendly, and full of people who can't stop.
dayIntro.red: Steeper. Icier. Sid's already asleep on the lift.
dayIntro.black: Moguls, ice and a sign that just says 'NON'.
dayIntro.offpiste: KFT says it's a shortcut. It is not a shortcut.
dayIntro.race: Last run of the week. First one to the bar buys the rounds.
